narr: A long wave trough moved across Arizona on on New Year's Day with bringing widespread precipitation. Snow levels were initially relatively high for this time of the year. The snow levels dropped rapidly as a cold front associated with the trough moved across the area. The heavy rain and rain on snow caused flooding in the lower elevations.
ev: A video on social media showed flash flooding on Wet Beaver Creek between Rim Rock and Lake Montezuma.
lsr: VIDEO ON FB SHOWS FLASH FLOODING AT BEAVER CREEK BRIDGE BETWEEN RIMROCK AND LAKE MONTEZUMA.
